claims.text: Upadacitinib (Crohn disease): induction 45 mg once daily for 12 weeks, then 15 mg once daily (30 mg may be considered for refractory, severe or extensive disease).
claims.quote: The recommended induction dosage of RINVOQ is 45 mg once daily for 12 weeks. The recommended maintenance dosage of RINVOQ is 15 mg once daily. A maintenance dosage of 30 mg once daily may be considered for patients with refractory, severe, or extensive disease.
